title: Bulk change that succeeds shows how many parts were updated
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A], [Part-B], [Part-C] = tracked parts, active, numbers sharing the start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-0.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BOK A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BOK A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BOK B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BOK B).
  5. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BOK C), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-03), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  6. [Part-C] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-03); [Desc-C] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BOK C).
  7. Check the setup worked: the three parts are on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOK-0", turn on "Deactivate parts", tick [Part-A] and [Part-B], click "Deactivate" and confirm with "Deactivate".
  2. Read the message at the bottom right and wait 10 seconds.
  3. Turn on "Deactivate parts" again, tick [Part-C], click "Deactivate" and confirm.
  4. Read the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: A green message reads "2 parts updated." and fades on its own; [Part-A] and [Part-B] have left the Active tab.
  • Step 4: A green message reads "1 part updated."; [Part-C] has left the Active tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R12, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.5 (Done: "2 parts updated."). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “"{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one)”
  • S10-R12: “After a bulk change, the system shows how many parts changed and how many failed.”
